name: code-block-highlight
description: The code block's shiki engine and pure helpers, with no "use client" so a server loader can call it. `highlightCode(code, options)` returns plain-JSON `CodeBlockLine[]` (dual light/dark token colors, line state from props or shiki transformers, unchanged lines reused so streaming re-renders one row). shiki loads lazily on the JavaScript regex engine (no WebAssembly), one chunk per language from the static `codeBlockLanguages` map and per theme from `codeBlockThemes` (`github-light`/`github-dark`, or `css-variables` for design-token colors). Also `parseLineSpec` (`"2-4,7"`), `markdownFences` / `markdownCodeProps` for AI transcripts, `ansiToLines` for terminal output, `parseUnifiedDiff` for git patches and `stripNotationComments`.
